name: KeeperHub (via ElizaOS adapter)
description: Wraps the @keeperhub/elizaos plugin as native OpenClaw tools using @elizaos/openclaw-adapter. Gives any OpenClaw agent 19 KeeperHub actions: DeFi protocols, token transfers, workflow execution, contract reads, ENS resolution, and agent identity.
author: KeeperHub Agent SDK

KEEPERHUB_API_KEY.description: KeeperHub API key (kh_ prefix). Get from app.keeperhub.com -> Settings -> API Keys.

KEEPERHUB_BASE_URL.description: KeeperHub base URL. Defaults to https://app.keeperhub.com

testnetOnly.description: Block all mainnet write calls. Recommended for development.
